test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements."

**Statements:**

 
• Some plants are rocks.
 
• No vegetable is a plant.

**Conclusions:**

I. No vegetable is a rock.

II. Some rocks are plants.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ae24a164bc3792063d5f0b5f68f1837d8a37292c286d49c10d2ddb3d304040.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No vegetable is a rock → **Does not **follow (As some plants are rocks and no vegetable is a plant. As no direct relation is given between vegetable and rocks, therefore it is false)

II. Some rocks are plants → Follow (As some plants are rocks. As some part of plants is common with rocks, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows. ​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
